headline: Healthcare that takes time to *listen*.
lede: Premier Wellness Telehealth provides compassionate, HIPAA-compliant virtual care for adults across Arizona, Florida, Virginia, and Washington — convenient, personalized care from the comfort and privacy of your home.
bio:
Lissette Moody is a doctorally prepared, board-certified adult nurse practitioner and the founder of Premier Wellness Telehealth. A registered nurse since 2006 and a nurse practitioner for 15 years, she has cared for adults in primary care, transitional care, and inpatient setting, with experience in women's health and a focus on preventive health, chronic condition support,

She founded the practice to give adults convenient access to thoughtful, personalized care, without the time pressure of traditional healthcare settings.

Her approach centers on listening carefully, explaining recommendations clearly, and involving patients in decisions about their health. 

Licensed in: Arizona, Florida, Virginia, and Washington State. Patients must be located in one of these states at the time of their visit.
